_doc: Win-rate bands of the reference teams against the Wardens per difficulty (plan area 2, item 733). [low, high]. Tamer has no ring cap. Act I is the tutorial act since Ali asked for an easier game (2026-11-21, Chimora 100 item 12): the Tamer teams of Orrin and Maelis sit one or two rings over the base teams again, so the reference teams at the old cap win some of the time (measured 21 Nov at 60 battles: Orrin 57 %, Maelis 27 %; before 0-2 %). The plan's [0.7, 0.92] would need Tamer teams at or under the base teams, which takes Act I out of its own band (tools/balance/act_route.json).
